title: Internet in Atlanta, GA: Providers, Fiber, Cable, 5G (2026)
description: Internet in Atlanta, GA: Xfinity cable, AT&T Fiber and 5G home by ZIP code, from FCC data. See who reaches you and what to ask before signing up.
lead: Who serves Atlanta, where fiber has reached, and how cable and 5G compare, by ZIP code.
short_answer: In June 2026 FCC data, Xfinity cable reaches most homes in 42 of Atlanta's 45 ZIP codes and AT&T Fiber in 19. Verizon and T-Mobile 5G home internet reach most homes in 38 and 37. See who serves your ZIP code and what to ask before you sign up.

sections.h2: Every provider reporting service in Atlanta (45 ZIP codes)

sections.body_html: Source: FCC Broadband Data Collection, June 30, 2026, matched to ZIP codes by YourBillCheck. "ZIP codes served" counts the 45 ZIP codes with a Atlanta postal address where each provider reports service to at least 10% of locations, so it includes a few areas outside city limits and is a guide, not a promise for your street. Top speed is the fastest plan the provider reports in the city, and many homes cannot get it.

sections.h2: Cable, fiber or 5G: how Atlanta's networks compare
sections.body_html:
Xfinity cable is the one network that reaches almost every Atlanta home. Fiber is patchier: AT&T Fiber reaches most homes in under half of Atlanta's ZIP codes, and Google Fiber reports service in about half of them.

Cable: Xfinity reports cable in 45 Atlanta ZIP codes and covers most homes in 42 of them, with top speeds of 2 Gbps.

Fiber: AT&T reports fiber in 45 ZIP codes and covers most homes in 19. AT&T's own Atlanta page lists plans from 300 Mbps to 1 Gig and speeds up to 5 Gbps where available, depending on address. Google Fiber is now branded GFiber and, per March 2026 reports, is merging with Astound.

5G home internet: Verizon reaches most homes in 38 ZIP codes and T-Mobile in 37. Speeds are lower and vary more than wired plans (T-Mobile reports up to 100 Mbps and Verizon up to 300 Mbps here). These plans are worth a look if you want no contract and a simple bill, and they are the main alternative where fiber is missing.

In just 19 of 45 Atlanta ZIP codes does at least one fiber network reach most homes (75% or more of locations): 30304, 30310, 30311, 30315, 30316, 30317, 30319, 30327, 30328, 30331, 30338, 30342, 30344, 30345, 30346, 30349, 30350, 30354, 30360. In the other 26, fiber is partial or absent, so cable or 5G are the realistic choices for many homes.

Partial means your street may still have fiber while your neighbor's does not. Enter your address on the provider's site, or use our fiber checker, before assuming either way.

sections.h2: What to ask before you sign up
sections.body_html:
1. Is my exact address on fiber or cable? Providers report coverage by area, and availability differs street by street.
  2. What is the price after the promotion, and is there a price lock? Compare the price in month 13, not month 1.
  3. Is there a data allowance, installation fee or equipment charge?
  4. For 5G home internet: what speed does my address get, and is there a trial period?

Run a speed test on your current plan first, and use the low-income internet checker if you may qualify for a discount. If your bill has crept up, read why your internet bill went up and our guide to internet fees.
See every Atlanta-area provider and ZIP code on our Atlanta provider list, or the Georgia overview. Or run the availability checker with your ZIP code.

faq: What is the main internet provider in Atlanta?

Xfinity cable is the most widely available wired network, covering most homes in 42 of 45 Atlanta ZIP codes in June 2026 FCC data. AT&T Fiber reports service in 45 ZIP codes and covers most homes in 19.
Yes. AT&T Fiber covers most homes in 19 of 45 Atlanta ZIP codes. In 19 ZIP codes at least one fiber network reaches most homes, and in 26 fiber is partial or absent. Check your address.
Can I get 5G home internet in Atlanta?
Yes. Verizon reports 5G home internet reaching most homes in 38 of 45 Atlanta ZIP codes and T-Mobile in 37. Speeds vary by address, so use each provider's address check.
Is satellite internet available in Atlanta?
Starlink reports service across Atlanta, and HughesNet and Viasat may also report service. For most Atlanta homes a wired or 5G plan is faster and cheaper, so satellite is a last resort.
